evidence_note: Complete enumeration of the lots of al-Qabisi's Chapter V (jumal al-sihaam), read directly from the Arabic of the Wurzburg TEI witness. The Islamicate defensibility spec recorded this chapter as '~50 lots' and the engine reported them as sourced-but-not-enumerated; the Arabic actually gives 81, and they are all here: 48 natal lots across the twelve houses, 7 further lots 'much used by the practitioners of the judgments of the stars', 4 kingship and world-year lots including the two greatest lots for the duration of a reign, and 23 commodity-price lots. Every lot carries its Arabic name, its from-point, its to-point, the point it is cast from, whether al-Qabisi says it reverses by night, and whether it needs a house cusp or the Midheaven - which this section cannot compute, so those 7 are NAMED AS OMITTED rather than approximated. Five lots are cast from something other than the Ascendant (Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury, the Sun, the Moon) and are flagged, because an implementation that assumes the Ascendant everywhere will silently misplace them. Four attributed forks are preserved rather than merged into 'al-Qabisi says': Hermes against Valens on the marriage lot, al-Andarzaghar's second slaves lot which he says is to be used ALONGSIDE rather than instead, al-Andarzaghar's dissent on the nocturnal reversal of the friends lot, and Hermes against unnamed ancients on the enemies lot. 38 lots carry output_policy 'refused' - death and killing, imprisonment, illness and disability, progeny count and sex, paternity doubt, war, mundane and dynastic prediction, and the whole commodity-price block, whose weakness al-Qabisi himself flags in his own closing sentence. They are encoded and refused rather than skipped, because a pack that drops them cannot honestly claim to have read the chapter.

conclusion.arabic: وإذا قلنا في بعض السهام خذ من موضع كذا إلى موضع كذا وألقه من الطالع أو من موضع آخر وهو أن تزيد على ما بين الموضعين درج الطالع أو الدرج التي في ذلك البرج الذي تلقي منه ثمّ تلقي ذلك من أوّل برج الطالع أو من أوّل البرج الذي يلقى منه
conclusion.engine_rendering: When we say of some lot: take from such a place to such a place and cast it from the Ascendant or from another place - that means, add to what lies between the two places the degrees of the Ascendant, or the degrees within that sign from which you cast; then cast that from the beginning of the sign of the Ascendant, or from the beginning of the sign from which the casting is made.

worked_example.arabic: مثال ذلك عمل سهم السعادة فإنّك تأخذ ما بين الشمس والقمر وتلقيه من الطالع
worked_example.note: al-Qabisi gives the Fortune formula in the diurnal direction as his illustration of the method and does not state the nocturnal reversal here; he states 'wa-bi'l-layl mukhalifan' (and by night the contrary) individually on each lot that reverses. Lots where he does NOT say it are encoded as not reversing, because he is explicit and consistent about which ones do.

conclusion.night_reversal_marker: بالليل مخالفا - 'and by night the contrary', i.e. swap the from-point and the to-point
conclusion.engine_note: The existing islamicate.py cast_lot() already implements this projection. What it lacked was the enumeration; this manifest supplies it.

conclusion.arabic: فإنّا نتبعها بعمل السهام التي تقع في تحويل سني العالم والقرانات الدالّة على أمور الملك وكم بقاء الملك
conclusion.engine_rendering: We follow them with the working of the lots that fall in the revolutions of the years of the world, and the conjunctions signifying the affairs of kingship, and how long the kingdom endures.

lots.arabic_name: سهم الملك والسلطان المستعمل في تحويل سني العالم
lots.transliteration: sahm al-mulk fi tahwil sini al-'alam
lots.english_name: Lot of kingship and authority used in the revolutions of the years of the world
lots.cast_from: the Ascendant of the conjunction signifying the transfer of the milla
lots.note: REFUSED: mundane/dynastic. al-Qabisi gives two further variants: (2) from the degree of the conjunction's Ascendant to the degree of the conjunction, cast from the degree of the revolution's Ascendant; (3) from the degree of the Sun to the Midheaven of the revolution, cast from the degree of Jupiter.

lots.english_name: Lot of the duration of the kingdom
lots.note: REFUSED. Taken at the moment of the king's accession, and it is a PAIR: then from the Moon to fifteen degrees of Cancer, cast from the Sun.

lots.english_name: Another lot for the duration of the king's standing
lots.cast_from: the Ascendant of the year-revolution in which the king rose
lots.note: REFUSED. Three conditional variants are stated: (a) if Jupiter is in a bicorporeal sign, the revolution is diurnal and Jupiter is cadent from the angles, take from Saturn to Jupiter, add thirty degrees, and cast from the Ascendant; (b) if Saturn and Jupiter are in opposition and both cadent from the Ascendant, halve what comes out between them and cast from the Ascendant; (c) if Jupiter is in its exaltation and the revolution is nocturnal, reckon from it to Saturn and cast from the Ascendant.

two_greatest_lots.arabic: عمل السهمين الأعظمين المستخرج بهما مدّة قيام الملك
two_greatest_lots.engine_rendering: The working of the two greatest lots, by which the duration of the king's standing is extracted.
two_greatest_lots.first_lot: At the moment of the king's accession, see where the year has reached from the conjunction of the triplicity that signified the milla, reckoning every thirty degrees a year and every two and a half degrees a month. Note the sign and degree; that is the place from which the first lot is equated. Then erect the Ascendant of the revolution of the year in which the king rose, take from the ORIENTAL of Saturn and Jupiter with respect to the Sun in that year to the noted degree, and cast it from the Ascendant of the revolution.
two_greatest_lots.second_lot: See from the conjunction in which the king rose to what sign and degree the year has reached, reckoning every thirty degrees a year, on the day and month in which the king rose; that is the place of equation of the second lot. Then take from the OCCIDENTAL of Saturn and Jupiter with respect to the Sun to that noted place, and cast it from the Ascendant of the revolution.
two_greatest_lots.both_same_condition: If both are oriental or both occidental, take the first from Saturn and the second from Jupiter.

conclusion.why_encoded: Encoded and refused, not skipped. The refusal list already bans mundane and dynastic prediction; the point of encoding is that a scholar can see the corpus knows the doctrine and has chosen not to render it, which is a different claim from not having it.

conclusion.arabic: وهاهنا سهام تستعمل في تحويل سني العالم يعرف بها ما يغلو من الأسعار وما يرخص
conclusion.engine_rendering: And here are lots used in the revolutions of the years of the world, by which is known what rises in price and what falls.

judgment_rule.arabic: فإن كان ذلك الكوكب في الرجوع أو الاحتراق أو موضع رديء رخص ذلك الشيء وإن كان في موضع قوّة أو وتد سيّما وسط السماء غلا ذلك الشيء وعزّ
judgment_rule.engine_rendering: Look to where the lot falls, in the house, exaltation, bound or triplicity of which planet. If that planet is retrograde, or combust, or in a bad place, that commodity falls in price; if it is in a place of strength or in an angle, especially the Midheaven, that commodity rises in price and becomes scarce. If the lord of that house arrives at the place of its fall, the commodity cheapens. And look to the aspect of the benefics and malefics to it, and to the Moon and its lord: if the benefics and the Moon aspect the lot, that commodity becomes plentiful; if the malefics aspect, it is spoiled.

the_authors_own_caveat.arabic: وإنّما أتينا هذه السهام الأخيرة وإن كان القول فيها ضعيفا لئلّا نترك شيئا ممّا يجوز أن يكون مدخلا إلى صناعة أحكام النجوم إلّا أتينا به
the_authors_own_caveat.engine_rendering: We have given these last lots, even though the discourse concerning them is WEAK, so as not to leave out anything that may serve as an introduction to the art of the judgments of the stars.
the_authors_own_caveat.note: This is al-Qabisi's own assessment of his own material, preserved rather than invented. It does not soften the refusal - the refusal is ours and is about economic prediction - but it does mean the corpus is refusing something the author himself flagged.

conclusion.refusal_basis: No commodity-price or economic prediction. Already in the islamicate refusal list.
